steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required withdrawal visibility configuration.
Ensure live-event withdrawal behavior matches the case configuration.
Open the RFQ stage on the prepared event.
Reach the Responses tab where the case opens Settings.
Record the expected live no-bid state before opening Recreate Order.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify the Recreate Order window closed.
Verify the event remains live after cancellation.
Verify the no-bid Responses state is unchanged.
Verify no error or rendering issue resulted from cancelling.
